# FlySquid

> FlySquid is a growth marketing agency. We manage paid ads on Meta, Google, TikTok and Snap, and set up an AI sales agent on WhatsApp, Instagram DMs and SMS that replies to leads within seconds in Arabic, English or French and books appointments.

- Company: Fly Squid FZ LLC, registered in Ras Al Khaimah, United Arab Emirates. The team works remotely.
- Regions: North America, MENA and the GCC.
- Languages: Arabic, English and French. The site is available in all three.
- Industries: clinics and hospitals, home care agencies, real estate, schools and education, e-commerce, and other service businesses.
- Services: AI Sales Agent, Paid Advertising, Creative Content and Social Media, Websites and Landing Pages, SEO and Search Marketing, Email Marketing, Influencer Marketing.
- Terms: month to month, no minimum term, 30 days’ written notice. Billed monthly in advance in US dollars. Clients pay ad platforms directly.
- Onboarding: about 14 days for most clients.
- Published result: a private hospital booked 85 appointments from 205 ad leads in one quarter (41.5%), up from 10 to 20% with manual replies.
- Contact: +971 58 682 5790 (UAE), +1 438 542 7737 and +1 514 714 4535 (Canada), WhatsApp https://wa.me/971586825790
